# unifi_network_threat_management (Resource)

UniFi **Threat Management** (IDS/IPS) — the site `ips` settings singleton. `mode` toggles the engine off (`disabled`), detection-only (`ids`), or prevention (`ips`/`ipsInline`); `enabled_categories` selects the threat signature categories. Writes shallow-merge the configured fields over the controller's stored section, so unmodeled fields (per-network honeypot entries) are preserved. There is one document per site; destroy removes the resource from state without disabling Threat Management.

**Enabling IDS/IPS requires a UniFi gateway (UDM/UCG/USG) with an active CyberSecure subscription.** Without it the controller accepts the write but silently keeps the engine `disabled`; the provider detects that and fails with a clear error rather than looping on drift. A console with no gateway is rejected at plan time. `mode = "disabled"` (and the non-engine flags) work everywhere.

**The enabled (non-`disabled`) write path is modeled from the reverse-engineered controller spec and has NOT been verified against live IDS/IPS hardware — no CyberSecure-licensed console was available. See the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `advanced_filtering_preference` (String) Advanced (per-category) filtering: `manual` to manage categories explicitly, or `disabled`.
- `content_filtering_blocking_page_enabled` (Boolean) Show a block page when content filtering denies a request.
- `enabled_categories` (Set of String) Threat signature categories to enable (e.g. `emerging-malware`, `botcc`, `tor`). Set to `[]` to clear every category; omit the attribute to leave the controller's selection unmanaged.
- `enabled_networks` (Set of String) Network (`networkconf`) ids the engine inspects. Omit to leave the controller's selection (typically all networks) unmanaged.
- `honeypot_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the honeypot feature. Per-network honeypot IP entries are managed by the controller and are not modeled here.
- `memory_optimized` (Boolean) Trade detection coverage for lower memory use on constrained gateways.
- `mode` (String) Engine mode: `disabled` (off), `ids` (detection — log only), `ips` (prevention — block), or `ipsInline` (prevention, inline on the data path).
- `restrict_torrents` (Boolean) Block BitTorrent / peer-to-peer traffic.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of the Threat Management singleton (`ips`).
